specification.status: Supplementary post hoc checks on archive and outcomes already examined; no independent confirmation, pre-registration or 2022 analysis
specification.pairing: Each configuration has unrestricted U(K), score-only B(K,C), and same-C/same-noncore N(K,C,m). No arbitrary Cartesian grid.
specification.budget_axes: Fixed C9,m3 across K20/30/50; separately fixed .30 core share and .10 unfamiliar minimum, exact 6/2,9/3,15/5. These estimate distinct changes.
specification.capacity_common_support: Within every task/ranker/axis, use situations feasible for every listed configuration before comparing the parameter curve. Report individual feasible support as well.
specification.strict_feasibility: Keep candidate, core, noncore, unfamiliar and m>C failures; never cap strict rules. Existing electronic admission failures remain original exclusions.
specification.existing_allocation_values: V7 already gives C6/12 at m3 and all C0/3/6/9/12/15/30 m0. New focal allocation comparisons add only C3/15 m3 with C9 anchor.
specification.inference_family: Exactly four 3-year task-link mean contrasts N(30,9,3)-B(30,9): two tasks by two rankers, all feasible fixed pools

inference.organization: Shared global normalized organization keys per draw; all years/tasks/rankers retain shared sampled counts
inference.crossed: Shared global organization and patent Exp(1) multipliers per draw. Fixed-list signed numerators; complete-pool 1/pool_n denominators.
inference.simultaneous_range: Centered maximum standardized absolute bootstrap departure over four contrasts; common 95th percentile critical value times each empirical bootstrap SD. No p-values or guarantees of exact nominal coverage.
inference.scope: Organization ranges are approximate bootstrap simultaneous intervals; crossed counterparts are simultaneous fixed-list dependence sensitivities.

random_reference.exact_matching: Same noncore IDs and same actual unfamiliar-core count as deterministic N9m3; uniform sampling without replacement separately among unfamiliar and familiar core candidates
random_reference.main: Analytic exact expected task/general yield under the matched uniform reference
random_reference.interpretation: Descriptive random reference for ranking within feasible composition, not causal placebo. Seeds add no independent organizations.

window_check.lists: Fixed old U/B9m0/N9m3/legacy/match lists; identical origin situations for all windows
window_check.maturity: Release ends2024-12-31; 2020/2021 excluded from every horizon comparison including shorter horizons, so all five-year windows complete
window_check.filters: Original known citing-owner, no owner overlap, no same application, future citing-grant dates; original CPC/IPC task flags
window_check.mandatory_validation: New 3-year task/general indicators equal every old label for the included candidate IDs; five-year battery also matches old cached five-year labels
